name: ORB 15, taken only when aggressor flow INSIDE the opening range agrees with the break
why: Who was aggressive while the opening range formed is who absorbed the open auction's orders; a break in their direction is the range's own demand completing, a break against them is a stop run the range's buyers (sellers) take back. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_orb_order_flow.md, test 2).
